Subject: Hypervisor gap-map & dedicated trial — post-call asks

Hi Tom / Priya,

Thanks for the time today. Quick recap + concrete asks so we can get the dedicated trial moving:

- Competitive snapshot (high-level):
  - Hyperscaler (XCloud): easier provisioning but variable latency under contention, limited KV/prefix caching; higher egress costs.
  - Redwood Dedicated: deterministic GPU pools, prefix/KV caching, policy-based routing and built-in failover to hosted models.

Agreed next steps / asks:
1) Trial scope: 4-week dedicated pool (4x A100-equivalent) for throughput + tail latency tests. Owner: Helix to nominate.
2) Test matrix: steady-state throughput, 95/99/99.9 latency percentiles, cold-starts, KV-cache hit/miss scenarios, multi-region failover.
3) Acceptance criteria: tail latency < 500ms (95p) at target qps; <2% error rate.
4) Security: we'll need SOC2 scope + POA for network/IP allowlisting (attached SLA draft + gap matrix).
5) Pricing/commit: we'll share a reserved-capacity price range; final depends on commit length.

Attachments: [hyperscaler-gap-matrix.xlsx], [redwood-dedicated-sla-draft.pdf]

Can you confirm the trial owner and whether 4 weeks is OK? Also confirm who on your security team to loop into the SOC2 scoping.

Best,
Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
